ml_demo.code:
import torch, torch.nn as nn, numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
X, y = make_moons(300, noise=0.2, random_state=0)
Xt = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32); yt = torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1,1)
def run(lr):
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2,16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(16,1))
    opt = torch.optim.SGD(net.parameters(), lr); lf = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(); L = []
    for _ in range(120):
        opt.zero_grad(); loss = lf(net(Xt), yt); loss.backward(); opt.step(); L.append(min(loss.item(), 2.0))
    return L
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,6.5))
ax.plot(run(0.001), color=CYAN, lw=3.5, label='muy chico (se atora)')
ax.plot(run(60), color=RED, lw=3.5, label='muy grande (explota)')
ax.plot(run(0.3), color=GREEN, lw=3.5, label='justo (baja suave)')
ax.set_title('el learning rate lo decide todo')
ax.legend(loc='upper right'); ax.set_xlabel('pasos'); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
